title: [AAPS3.0_beta2] NSClient - Cant silence alarm while sync in progress
body:
While setting up fresh and (still, presumably) syncing NS data, the main graph doesn't display, not do any of the info pills/widgets or profile. Basically most features don't seem to work.

I got a loud "last loop" 30 minutes ago alarm in NSClient, because I walked away from my OpenAPS rig.

While NSClient is in this state there is no way to snooze or dismiss this alarm. I had to turn my phone off until I had returned to my rig and another loop completed.
